intent: Publish a loopback service at <name>.kuhy.duckdns.org through the existing gitea-caddy edge with one validated command.
scope: Non-goal: no change to the live Caddy config, setup_gitea.sh or DNS
changes: Writes sites/<name>.kuhy.duckdns.org.caddy (reverse_proxy to 127.0.0.1:<port>, optional bearer gate), validates on a tmp copy in a throwaway caddy:2.8 container, then reloads gitea-caddy

verification.command: publish_caddy_site.sh todo 8799 --dry-run (with and without a token file)
verification.evidence: caddy validate: Valid configuration, exit 0; live edge not modified

risks: A real run reloads the shared edge; a bad snippet is caught by the pre-validation, but a reload still briefly touches all sites
rollback: Delete ~/services/gitea/sites/<name>.kuhy.duckdns.org.caddy and run docker exec gitea-caddy caddy reload --config /etc/caddy/Caddyfile
